title: fix(objectql)!: the registry fold merges validation rules by name; a tenant's same-named copy carries only its message and active, and a changed condition is reported at load, never run
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoSvkSSxNZcoCwT3AFsNcUvy)_

Fixes #27949 (the load-path half of ruling B; the save-door refusal is a follow-up card the seat files, `Blocked-by:` this PR).

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

Ruling-ref: 6545641964 (letter B, maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-31T15:47Z), under ruling 6524229156 (letter C′, maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-30T13:40Z).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：同一对象里的校验规则按 `name` 合并，不再把各层的规则数组拼接。租户覆盖层里与包内规则同名的副本只取它的 `message` 和 `active`，条件和类型始终用包里的；不同名的规则照旧叠加。加载时发现副本改了条件或类型，只记一条 `error` 日志并照包的规则执行，不抛错。ADR-0029 D9.2a 加一段带日期的说明。
- 为什么改：租户在 Studio 里改写扩展包某条规则的提示语后，旧折叠会让两条同名规则同时生效，被拒的写入会报两句话；同时租户复制的规则会冻结住，包里后来的修复到不了租户。
- 风险与回滚：改了条件的租户副本不再执行自己的条件，改由包的条件判定（启动日志点名该规则）；升级不会因存量数据失败。没有任何键的增删。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `mergeValidationsByName` 与 `withPackagedOwnerRules`、`reportChangedRuleCopies`（只报告不拒绝）；`docs/adr/0029-…md` 的 D9.2a 说明。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/registry-validation-rule-by-name.test.ts`，预期 14 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 改了 `docs/adr/**`（Tier H），合约复审通过后请用 os-zhuang 批准。

## What changes

**The fold merges `validations` by name** (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`). A validation rule's identity within an object is its `name`, so `mergeObjectDefinitions` no longer concatenates the arrays. `mergeValidationsByName` lets a later layer's rule replace every earlier rule of its name, and adds a rule of a new name. Rules of different names stay additive, as ADR-0029 D9.2a protects. Between two code layers, the later layer's same-named rule replaces the earlier one, the way a field does.

**What a tenant's copy carries.** When the fold's base is a tenant overlay (or a runtime-authored owner), `tenantRuleSettings` reads each rule's `message` and `active` by name, first copy wins. The packaged rule runs with those two keys and nothing else from the copy:

- `withPackagedOwnerRules` replaces a copy of the packaged OWNER's rule with the owner's rule plus the copy's `message` / `active`, so a later package fix to that rule reaches the tenant.
- An extension's rule is merged the same way through `mergeValidationsByName`.
- `active: false` on the copy switches the rule off.
- A rule the overlay leaves out stays out, as D9.2's replace has always meant.

**Load path: report, never refuse (ruling B).** `reportChangedRuleCopies` compares each tenant copy with the packaged rule set (`packagedRules`). The comparison reads omitted keys at the schema defaults, so a parse that stamped `events` / `priority` / `severity` is not a change. A copy that changes anything beyond `message` and `active` is named once per registry at `error` (`validation_rule_copy_changed`), with its consequence and the ruling's prescription. The fold has already run the package's rule. Nothing throws, so a package upgrade never fails a boot on stored data.

**Predicate for the save door.** `SchemaRegistry.tenantRuleCopyRefusal(name, body)` returns `ValidationRuleCopyRefusedError` (`INVALID_METADATA`, 422, `objectName`, `ruleName`, `changedKeys` with `type` first, the prescription in the message) for a body that changes a packaged rule's condition or type, and `null` otherwise. Nothing calls it yet. Wiring it into the metadata save door is the follow-up card. Under B, `registerObject` needs no build-time refusal, and this PR adds none.

**Idempotence (#8027).** `subtractExtenderContributions` no longer subtracts `validations`. The by-name merge already replaces every base copy of an extender's rule name, so a folded base re-folds to itself. Subtracting first would also strip the tenant's `message` / `active` off a reworded copy before the fold reads them. `getPackagedObjectBase` serves the packaged rules merged by name the same way.

**ADR-0029 D9.2a** gains a dated note recording both rulings: rules of different names add; a same-named rule merges by name with the condition owned by the package; the loud refusal sits at the save door; the load path only reports.

**Changeset** `.changeset/27949-validation-rules-merge-by-name.md`: `@objectstack/objectql` `patch` (ruling A: `Metadata-protocol: none` grades every entry `patch`), carrying the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 `not-required` disposition.

**Tests.**

- New `registry-validation-rule-by-name.test.ts` has 14 cases in five blocks: a reworded copy is one rule; a changed condition or type is refused by the predicate and never runs at load; `active: false` deactivates; different names add; and re-folding is idempotent, including a legacy row stored while the fold still appended.
- `engine-validation-tenant-rewrite.test.ts` changes one expectation. The extension rule is now served and refused once, with the tenant's sentence, on every header (before: the tenant's copy plus the translated original).

## Tests

All on head `e5e62b28` (seat 4's `2a499b92` merged with `main` `630b4078`, then the ruling-B changeset and ADR alignment).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 507/507, Tests 9847/9847.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`, debt held).

<details><summary>12 one-time ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob, git diff HEAD empty after each)</summary>

Run: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/registry-validation-rule-by-name.test.ts src/engine-validation-tenant-rewrite.test.ts` (18 cases). The suite imports `./registry.js` from source, so no dist rebuild is involved. Every mutation went red:

| # | mutation in `registry.ts` | red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A01 | `mergeValidationsByName` concatenates again | 8 failed / 18 |
| A02 | the tenant's `message` is not read | 8 failed |
| A03 | the tenant's `active` is not read | 1 failed (`active: false` deactivates) |
| A04 | `tenantRuleSettings` answers `undefined` | 7 failed |
| A05 | `withPackagedOwnerRules` is a no-op (owner copy keeps its own condition) | 1 failed (a package fix reaches the tenant) |
| A06 | the tenant copy's condition is carried into the fold | 2 failed (owner fix; changed condition never runs) |
| A07 | `tenantRuleCopyRefusal` never refuses | 2 failed (condition, type) |
| A08 | `packagedRules` skips extension rules | 5 failed |
| A09 | schema defaults not applied before comparing | 1 failed (stamped defaults change nothing) |
| A10 | the load report is not called | 1 failed (reported once) |
| A11 | the report's once-per-registry guard removed | 1 failed (reported once) |
| A12 | tenant settings take the last copy, not the first | 1 failed (legacy appended row) |

The first runs of A05, A06 and A08 were refused by the tool as no-ops (the replacement text was already counted in the file). They were re-anchored with distinct replacement text and re-run, and the numbers above come from those re-runs.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `tenantRuleCopyRefusal` has no caller in this PR, on purpose: ruling B puts the refusal at the save door (follow-up card behind the `protocol.ts` serial queue on #6367).
- A copy stored before a package upgrade changed the rule cannot be told apart from one the tenant changed. That is why the load path reports and runs the package's rule instead of refusing.
- The predicate compares every key except `message`, `active` and `_`-prefixed loader stamps, so it is stricter than "condition or type": any package-owned key (for example `fields`, `events`, `severity`) counts as a change. That matches C′'s "everything else is the package's".
- The commit subjects carry `!` from seat 4's commit. The changeset level follows `Metadata-protocol: none` (patch) under ruling A, and the BREAKING banner stays in its body.
